topics.title: HTML5 Document Structure & Metadata
topics.objective: Understand the DOCTYPE declaration, html/head/body hierarchy, viewport meta tags, and character sets.
topics.exercise: Create a valid, standards-compliant HTML5 boilerplate page with complete SEO and social meta tags.

topics.title: Semantic Layout Elements (header, nav, main, article, section, footer)
topics.objective: Structure web documents using semantic landmark tags to enhance accessibility and screen reader navigation.
topics.exercise: Convert a div-heavy landing page layout into semantic HTML5 landmark tags.

topics.title: Typography, Hyperlinks & Responsive Media (img, picture, audio, video)
topics.objective: Incorporate accessible hyperlinks, responsive srcset image tags, and embedded multimedia.
topics.exercise: Build an accessible media gallery with descriptive alt text and lazy loading attributes.

topics.title: Accessible Forms, Inputs & Client-Side Validation
topics.objective: Construct accessible user input forms with explicit label association, fieldsets, and HTML5 validation attributes.
topics.exercise: Design a registration form with name, email, password strength, and terms checkbox.

topics.title: Web Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 & WAI-ARIA Landmarks)
topics.objective: Apply ARIA roles, states, keyboard focus management, and color contrast principles.
topics.exercise: Audit an existing HTML form and eliminate all accessibility violations identified by WCAG 2.1 AA.
